name: defender-villas
description: Static site for Defender Villas (beach villas near Kodungallur). No runtime build step.

scripts.vendor: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['gsap','ScrollTrigger','SplitText'])fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/gsap/dist/'+f+'.min.js','vendor/gsap-3.15.0/'+f+'.min.js');for(const f of ['lenis.min.js','lenis.css'])fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/lenis/dist/'+f,'vendor/lenis-1.3.26/'+f)"
